Steamworks SDK  (not included, see the docs)  Valve         engine when present     https://partner.steamgames.com/

Why each library (this file is the canonical external library table; the docs repository links here):
- cgltf: single-file glTF loader.
- Dear ImGui: editor UI (never linked into the shipped game exe).
- ImGuizmo: 3D gizmo in the editor (never linked into the shipped game exe).
- Jolt Physics: deterministic build support, multithreaded, fast. Built with CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC and SSE4.2 only (AVX/FMA off) so it runs on office CPUs (Pentium, Celeron) and gives the same results everywhere.
- meshoptimizer: model optimization and LOD generation.
- Tracy: CPU/GPU profiling (only in `build.bat Profile`).
- Steamworks SDK: lobbies, friend invites, relay. Valve's terms forbid redistributing it, so it is not in the repository; put it in third_party/steamworks/sdk and CMake picks it up.

Generated by tools\gen_notices.ps1 from third_party/<lib>/mealkit.txt and LICENSE - do not edit by hand.
To add or update a library: copy its sources into third_party/<lib>/ (only the files needed to build, see 'kept'),
keep its LICENSE, write mealkit.txt (name, version, license, licenseFile, source, usedIn, inGame, kept, why) and run the script.
Shipped games include the notices (the export build merges the engine, game and font notices).
